'''Andrew Andorf''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Pleasanton tournament]] on 20 January 2001 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|MKOS Abyssins]], according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1653">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-pleasanton-ca-1-20-01d1653/ pleasanton-ca-1-20-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 21 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-pleasanton-ca-1-20-01d1653/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
